jn_01.m_zh: 温暖、好奇的开头，一口气说完；「上帝」轻轻扬起
jn_01.d_zh: 画面：你和孩子一起低头看一张大地图：左边是大海和一条小船，右边是一座大城。你用手指轻轻点着那个叫约拿的小人。
jn_01.m_en: warm, curious opening, in one breath; a little lift on 'God spoke'
jn_01.d_en: Picture: you and a child look down at a big map. The sea and a small ship on the left, a great city on the right. Your finger points at a little man called Jonah.

jn_02.m_zh: 温暖、平静、又大又和气，像慈爱的爸爸；不凶、不吓人
jn_02.d_zh: 画面：你像一位爸爸，早上轻轻叫醒孩子，交给他一件重要的事。你相信他能做到，声音很稳，一点也不急。
jn_02.m_en: warm, calm, big but kind, like a loving father; never stern or scary
jn_02.d_en: Picture: you are like a dad who wakes his child in the morning and gives him an important job. You trust him. Your voice is steady, not in a hurry.

jn_03.m_zh: 气鼓鼓、犟；「我才不去呢」前哼一声；好笑，不是真发火
jn_03.d_zh: 画面：你站在路中间，听到「尼尼微」三个字就把手往胸前一抱，头一扭，像小孩不肯吃青菜。
jn_03.m_en: grumpy and stubborn; a snort before 'No way'; funny, not really angry
jn_03.d_en: Picture: you stand in the road. When you hear 'Nineveh', you cross your arms and turn your head away, like a child who will not eat vegetables.

jn_04.m_zh: 觉得好笑，像说悄悄话；「相反方向」要惊讶
jn_04.d_zh: 画面：你凑到孩子耳边讲一个小秘密：约拿踮着脚尖往海边溜。说到船的方向，你眼睛都瞪圆了。
jn_04.m_en: amused, like sharing a secret; surprise on 'the opposite way'
jn_04.d_en: Picture: you lean close to a child and tell a secret. Jonah tiptoes down to the sea. When you say which way the ship goes, your eyes go wide.

jn_05.m_zh: 爽朗的大嗓门船长，胸腔里发声，带着笑；「开船啦」像隔着甲板喊
jn_05.d_zh: 画面：你站在船头，海风吹着胡子，拍拍新上船客人的肩膀，然后转身朝整条船的水手大喊。
jn_05.m_en: jolly, loud sea captain, big chest voice with a laugh; shout 'we're off' across the deck
jn_05.d_en: Picture: you stand at the front of the ship with sea wind in your beard. You pat the new passenger on the shoulder, then turn and shout to all the sailors.

jn_06.m_zh: 轻轻的、困困的，带着笑；「呼噜呼噜」拖长
jn_06.d_zh: 画面：你踮着脚走到船舱里，看见约拿缩在木箱和麻袋后面睡着了。你怕吵醒他，说得很轻。
jn_06.d_en: Picture: you tiptoe below deck and see Jonah asleep behind boxes and sacks. You speak softly so you do not wake him.

jn_07.m_zh: 刺激、快、眼睛睁大；「轰隆隆」要大；过瘾，但不吓人
jn_07.d_zh: 画面：天一下子黑了，闪电一亮，大浪把小船抛上抛下。你像坐过山车一样，抓紧孩子的手一起摇。
jn_07.m_en: exciting, quick, wide-eyed; big on 'Crash! Boom!'; thrilling, never scary
jn_07.d_en: Picture: the sky turns dark, lightning flashes, big waves throw the ship up and down. It is like a roller coaster. You hold the child's hand and rock together.

jn_08.m_zh: 顶着大风喊，着急、不敢相信；不是骂他，是真没办法了
jn_08.d_zh: 画面：雨打在脸上，你一只手死死抓着船舵，另一只手使劲摇睡着的约拿，得喊得比风还大他才听得见。
jn_08.m_en: shouting over the wind, urgent, amazed; not angry at him, just desperate
jn_08.d_en: Picture: rain hits your face. One hand holds the steering oar and the other shakes sleeping Jonah. You must shout louder than the wind.

jn_09.m_zh: 很轻、惭愧、老实；「是因为我」前咽一下口水；最后一句要勇敢
jn_09.d_zh: 画面：你站在船边，低着头，不敢看船长的眼睛。大家都在等你说话。说到最后一句，你抬起头，下定了决心。
jn_09.m_en: quiet, ashamed, honest; a swallow before 'because of me'; brave on the last sentence
jn_09.d_en: Picture: you stand at the side of the ship with your head down. You cannot look at the captain. Everyone waits. On the last sentence you lift your head, ready.

jn_10.m_zh: 吓一跳、心软、左右为难；「唉」是一声叹气；祷告是真心求
jn_10.d_zh: 画面：你连连摆手往后退，可是船快要散了。你抬头看着黑黑的天，把帽子摘下来按在胸口。
jn_10.m_en: shocked, kind, torn; a groan on 'Oh'; the prayer is a real plea
jn_10.d_en: Picture: you wave your hands and step back, but the ship is about to break. You look up at the dark sky and hold your hat on your chest.

jn_11.m_zh: 「扑通」要脆；然后压低声音，很惊奇，一切都静下来
jn_11.d_zh: 画面：水花溅起来，然后，像有人关掉了开关：风没了，浪平了，海面像镜子一样。你屏住呼吸看着。
jn_11.m_en: a pop on 'Splash', then hushed and amazed as all goes still
jn_11.d_en: Picture: water splashes up. Then it is like someone turned off a switch. No wind, no waves, the sea is flat like a mirror. You hold your breath.

jn_12.m_zh: 下沉时慢悠悠、飘飘的；说到大鱼时惊喜、带笑
jn_12.d_zh: 画面：约拿捏着鼻子在蓝蓝的水里慢慢往下飘，泡泡往上冒。忽然，一个比船还大的影子游过来了。
jn_12.m_en: slow and floaty on the sinking; wonder and a smile on 'great big fish'
jn_12.d_en: Picture: Jonah holds his nose and floats down in the blue water, bubbles going up. Then a shadow bigger than the ship swims in.

jn_13.m_zh: 夸张、好笑、开心；真的发出「啊呜」一口
jn_13.d_zh: 画面：大鱼张开山洞一样的大嘴。你也把嘴张到最大，像一口吞掉一个大包子。
jn_13.m_en: big, comic, happy; make a real 'gulp' sound
jn_13.d_en: Picture: the fish opens a mouth as big as a cave. You open your mouth wide too, like you eat a whole dumpling in one bite.

jn_14.m_zh: 好笑的嫌弃，捏着鼻子说（鼻音）；「滑溜溜」打个哆嗦
jn_14.d_zh: 画面：你坐在黑乎乎的鱼肚子里，一只手捏着鼻子，另一只手摸到一把黏黏的东西，赶紧甩掉。
jn_14.m_en: comic disgust, holding his nose (nasal voice); a shudder on 'slimy'
jn_14.d_en: Picture: you sit in the dark fish tummy. One hand holds your nose. The other hand touches something sticky, and you shake it off fast.

jn_15.m_zh: 平静，越说越慢；「向上帝祷告」要轻
jn_15.d_zh: 画面：四周黑黑的、静静的，只听见大鱼咚、咚的心跳。约拿不闹了，慢慢跪坐下来，低下头。
jn_15.m_en: calm, slowing down; gentle on 'he prayed'
jn_15.d_en: Picture: it is dark and quiet. You only hear the slow heartbeat of the fish. Jonah stops fussing, kneels down, and bows his head.

jn_16.m_zh: 真心的祷告，轻、近；先认错，再感谢，最后坚定；「谢谢你」前吸一口气
jn_16.d_zh: 画面：你跪在黑暗里，闭上眼睛，两手握在一起。没有别人，只有你和上帝，像睡前在被窝里小声祷告。
jn_16.m_en: a real prayer, soft and close; sorry, then thankful, then steady; breath before 'Thank You'
jn_16.d_en: Picture: you kneel in the dark, close your eyes, and fold your hands. No one else is there, only you and God. It is like a quiet prayer in bed at night.

jn_17.m_zh: 在铺垫一个笑话；最后一个字拖住
jn_17.d_zh: 画面：天亮了，大鱼游到沙滩边，腮帮子鼓鼓的。你憋着笑看着孩子，故意不往下说。
jn_17.m_en: building up to a joke; hold the last word
jn_17.d_en: Picture: daylight again. The fish swims to the beach with big round cheeks. You look at the child, try not to laugh, and wait.

jn_18.m_zh: 抖包袱：真的「呸」一声，然后轻轻笑
jn_18.d_zh: 画面：约拿像西瓜籽一样飞出来，一屁股坐在沙滩上，头上还顶着一条海带。
jn_18.m_en: the punchline: a real 'pfft', then a little laugh
jn_18.d_en: Picture: Jonah flies out like a watermelon seed and lands on his bottom on the sand. A piece of seaweed sits on his head.

jn_19.m_zh: 和第一次一样温暖的声音，有耐心，带一点笑意：再给一次机会
jn_19.d_zh: 画面：你看着沙滩上湿淋淋、头顶海带的约拿，像爸爸看着闯了祸又回来的孩子，不提旧事，再说一遍。
jn_19.m_en: the same warm voice as before, patient, a small smile: a second chance
jn_19.d_en: Picture: you look at wet Jonah on the sand with seaweed on his head, like a dad who looks at a child who came back. You do not talk about before. You just ask again.

jn_20.m_zh: 谦卑、笃定；很短；先深吸一口气
jn_20.d_zh: 画面：你从沙滩上站起来，把头上的海带拿掉，抬头看着天，站得直直的。
jn_20.m_en: humble and sure; short; a deep breath first
jn_20.d_en: Picture: you stand up on the sand, take the seaweed off your head, look up at the sky, and stand straight.

jn_21.m_zh: 对整座城喊话，手拢在嘴边；响亮、严肃，但不凶狠
jn_21.d_zh: 画面：你站在尼尼微高高的城门前，两手拢成喇叭。城墙那么高，你要让墙里面每一条街都听得见。
jn_21.m_en: calling to a whole city, hands around the mouth; loud and serious, not cruel
jn_21.d_en: Picture: you stand at the high gate of Nineveh with your hands around your mouth. The wall is very tall. Every street inside must hear you.

jn_22.m_zh: 一大群人，男女老少，声音不整齐，发自内心
jn_22.d_zh: 画面：你穿着粗麻衣，和邻居们一个接一个跪在城门口，前面还跪着国王。你抬头向天，真心地求。
jn_22.m_en: a big crowd, men, women and children, not together, from the heart
jn_22.d_en: Picture: you wear rough cloth and kneel at the gate with your neighbours, one after another. Even the king kneels. You look up to the sky and truly ask.

jn_23.m_zh: 高兴又温柔；「就原谅了他们」要暖、要慢
jn_23.d_zh: 画面：金色的光慢慢照在跪着的整座城上，像妈妈的手轻轻摸着孩子的头。你松了一口气，笑了。
jn_23.m_en: glad and gentle; warm and slow on 'He forgave them'
jn_23.d_en: Picture: golden light slowly covers the kneeling city, like a mother's hand on a child's head. You breathe out and smile.

jn_24.m_zh: 像输了游戏的小孩在赌气；「哼」要响；最后一句带哭腔；好笑
jn_24.d_zh: 画面：你咚咚咚爬上小山坡，一屁股坐下，手抱在胸前，头顶直冒烟，朝天上嘟着嘴抱怨。
jn_24.m_en: sulky like a child who lost a game; loud 'Hmph'; whiny last sentence; funny
jn_24.d_en: Picture: you stomp up a little hill, sit down hard, and fold your arms. Steam comes out of your head. You pout and complain to the sky.

jn_25.m_zh: 轻快、好玩；「啊，真凉快」是一声舒服的叹气
jn_25.d_zh: 画面：大热天，一棵绿油油的树嗖地长出来，叶子像大伞一样罩在约拿头上。就像你走进树荫，凉风一吹。
jn_25.m_en: light and playful; a happy sigh on 'lovely and cool'
jn_25.d_en: Picture: a very hot day. A green plant shoots up and its leaves cover Jonah like a big umbrella. It feels like stepping into shade with a cool wind.

jn_26.m_zh: 说小虫子时淘气（咔嚓咔嚓），然后又热又蔫
jn_26.d_zh: 画面：一条小虫子从树根探出头，咔嚓咔嚓啃得可香了。叶子一片片耷拉下来，大太阳直直晒在约拿的光头上。
jn_26.m_en: naughty on the worm ('munch, munch'), then hot and droopy
jn_26.d_en: Picture: a tiny worm pops out by the stem and munches happily. The leaves hang down one by one, and the hot sun shines right on Jonah's head.

jn_27.m_zh: 夸张地嚎，好笑；声音破掉
jn_27.d_zh: 画面：你两只手举向天，对着那棵干巴巴的树哭喊，像小孩心爱的冰淇淋掉在了地上。
jn_27.d_en: Picture: you throw both arms up and cry at the dry plant, like a child whose ice cream fell on the ground.

jn_28.m_zh: 非常温柔，像爸爸在讲道理；「还有好多牛羊」带一点笑；问句是心疼，不是责备
jn_28.d_zh: 画面：金色的光里，你在哭鼻子的约拿身边坐下，指给他看山下那座城：家家户户，小孩子，还有牛和羊。
jn_28.m_en: very gentle, a father explaining; small smile on 'animals too'; the question is tender, not scolding
jn_28.d_en: Picture: in golden light you sit down next to crying Jonah. You point at the city below: all the homes, the children, the cows and sheep.

jn_29.m_zh: 温暖的道理，直接对孩子说；最后一句带着笑
jn_29.d_zh: 画面：约拿转过身朝孩子挥手，远处海里的大鱼也挥了挥鳍。你看着孩子的眼睛，说到「你和我」时指指他，再指指自己。
jn_29.m_en: warm lesson, speaking right to the child; smile on the last sentence
jn_29.d_en: Picture: Jonah turns and waves, and far out at sea the big fish waves a fin. You look in the child's eyes. At 'you and me', point to the child and then to yourself.
